prompt: Create a high end real estate brochure spread for a new waterfront townhouse development. Left page features a hero architectural photograph at golden hour. Right page has the name HARBORSTONE QUARTER in a confident serif at the top, a paragraph of marketing copy, a small site plan diagram, and three key specs: 28 TOWNHOUSES, 3 TO 4 STOREYS, 6 RETAIL UNITS. Muted coastal stone palette. No watermark.
